item: NetworkManager keeps network-filesystem devices up through suspend: VM integration test

package_build.command: dpkg-buildpackage -us -uc -b in ubuntu:26.10 with the package test suite

vm.topology: two virtio-net NICs joined by QEMU unix dgram sockets; eth0 managed by NetworkManager (keyfile, static 192.0.2.2/24); eth1 moved to a network namespace running the NFS 4.1 server, 200 Mbit/s shaped
vm.sleep_trigger: org.freedesktop.NetworkManager.Sleep(true), the same do_sleep_wake path logind's PrepareForSleep drives
vm.freezer: pm_test=freezer, state=freeze, default 20 s timeout, pm_debug_messages=1
